cohort: 36 pediatric subjects with NMO, 491 with MS, and 224 healthy controls
finding: Daycare attendance and breastfeeding were associated with lower odds of having NMO, while cesarean delivery tended to be associated with higher odds of NMO.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery tended to be associated with 2-fold-higher odds of NMO compared with having MS/clinically isolated syndrome or with being healthy.
